description: Replace the active fault rules, so the vendor APIs fail the way real ones do. Each rule: { name, vendor: quickbooks|jobber|housecallpro, method?, pathIncludes?, pathExcludes?, rate: 0-1, effect: { status?: HTTP error status, latencyMs?, message?, lostResponse?: do the work, then answer with status } }. A rule with webhook: TOPIC or "*" (and no method, pathIncludes, or pathExcludes) affects webhook deliveries instead: effect { duplicate?: true, delayMs? }. An empty list turns faults off. Bad rules change nothing. Answers with the active rules' names.

rules.description: Every rule to keep active, shaped as above; [] turns faults off
